prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, reorder] Move sign-in after pet choice: Shift account sign-in to occur right after picking or building a pet, so users build emotional attachment before account creation. (why: Sign-in currently happens before pet selection, causing drop-off; adoption step conversion is low at 60.9%.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Redesign pet picking with live grid preview: Transform the pick_friend screen into a responsive grid layout featuring animated mascot previews and clear pet badges. (why: Adoption step has a high median time (89s) and 60.9% conversion, indicating high friction selecting pets.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop launch status and diagnostic flow on waiting: Add real-time progress steps and desktop display check tips to the waiting screen to verify desktop overlay compatibility. (why: Waiting/home screen mean duration is 2336s and 3 users reported pets missing on desktop or app not launching.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Clarify path options upfront: Update choose_path text to explicitly state the difference between quick instant adoption and custom photo-based creation. (why: The choose_path mean duration is 514s despite median 8s, indicating some users stall on deciding.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account cloud-save warning hint: Add explicit hint text on sign_in explaining that signing in links pets to your account so they won't disappear on restart. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, wait_info] Display notification toggle during generation wait: Enable progress bar, time estimate, and desktop readiness notification option on the waiting screen. (why: Finish step median is long (395s / mean 5815s) and overall completion rate is only 17.8%.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Split layout for path selection: Switch choose_path screen layout to a split view comparing Instant Adoption side-by-side with Custom Pet Creator. (why: 76.2% conversion on choose_path can be improved by providing side-by-side visual clarity.)
7: [adoption, hint] Photo requirement guidance tips: Add photo selection guidelines and preview tip on upload_photos screen to prevent custom pet generation failures. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
8: [finish, incentive] Desktop control cheat sheet on home intro: Add a visual controls keymap card and mascot welcome banner to home_intro. (why: 4 emails reported desktop feature misbehavior and 3 emails mentioned control confusion post-onboarding.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in after pet choice leverages emotional investment to fix adoption drop-off.
Grid redesign targets the lowest converting step (60.9%) and reduces selection friction.
Diagnostic flow addresses desktop launch complaints and long mean wait times.
Low cost copy update to resolve initial decision stalling.
Directly supported by 8 support emails with a simple low-cost hint.
Reduces drop-off during long generation waits at the finish stage.
Split layout visual comparison clarifies choose_path options.
Photo upload guidance reduces generation errors mentioned in support tickets.
Addresses post-onboarding control confusion backed by 7 support emails.
